label: Oak flavoured milk and coffee milk

branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: Oak is a pasteurised flavoured milk and coffee milk brand, now owned by Lactalis. It began in New South Wales in 1967 as a dairy co-operative label and reached other states in 1998.

sources.text: Its history and launch dates, from it.
